description: This Phase 3 study evaluates how well Rina-S works against ovarian cancer in combination with or without bevacizumab and how it compares to an investigator's choice of platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab.
title: Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Rina-S With or Without Bevacizumab Compared to Investigator's Choice of Platinum-based Chemotherapy With or Without Bevacizumab as Second-line Treatment in Participants With Recurrent Platinum-sensitive Ovarian Cancer (RAINFOL™-07)
